observations.behavior: Adds a single line to documentation, no implementation.
observations.code_quote: `src/lib/connectivity.ts` maps Expo Network events to `unknown`, `connected` or `offline` and keeps the connection type for prefetch. Unknown states permit reads. The monitor checks state on foreground entry and removes listeners on disposal. It sends no external probes and stores no network names or addresses. Connected state does not confirm backend availability.

observations.behavior: Adds a single line to documentation, no implementation.
observations.code_quote: It skips done and dismissed rows and sends one speculative request at a time, without retries. It runs only while the inbox is focused and foregrounded, the device reports a connected Wi-Fi or Ethernet link, and no observed foreground query is fetching. Unknown connection types and cellular links pause prefetch but do not block foreground reads. Pausing, switching project or account, or unmounting cancels only inactive queries started by the prefetcher. Opening a report adopts its shared requests, so cleanup leaves those observed reads running and failures use the foreground observer’s retry policy.

observations.behavior: Replaces NetInfo with expo-network, updates connectivity and network-type checks.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the mobile inbox prefetch behavior to use expo-network instead of NetInfo, and the connectivity check now also requires the network type to be WIFI or ETHERNET rather than just connected. This could affect when speculative reads are performed and could change behavior for cellular-only connections.
